svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given an open conflict with a side picked, a second conflict still open; beat 1: you press Resolve → the decision is recorded with the winning and losing file, the card is gone from Open — you stay there, the Settled count ticks up, a toast names it — and the Settled list offers the rewrite of the losing file; beat 2: you press Undo in the Settled list → the conflict returns to Open and you stay on Settled
